extracted.intended_audience: investigative journalists, newsroom managers and staff, journalism students and educators (including MSI students) seeking training opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Directory and descriptions of Investigative Reporters and Editors (IRE) training offerings (conferences, bootcamps, workshops, webinars, application-based programs, fellowships, and custom training) and eligibility/benefit details for journalists, newsrooms, and students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training mission / purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: One of IRE’s primary purposes is educating fellow journalists in the latest techniques of finding, understanding and reporting on stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IRE runs seminars and workshops worldwide to teach data and investigative journalism techniques; users are invited to explore different training options and find events (view calendar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Registration Training (umbrella)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publicly available training events that individuals can register for.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conferences, bootcamps, workshops and webinars listed separately; users can view calendar and register for open events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about our three annual conferences focusing on data and investigative journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three annual conferences are flagship events for data and investigative journalism; users should view conference pages for schedules, registration, and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bootcamps
rubrics_metrics.description: Our bootcamps provide intensive, hands-on training in core data journalism skills and software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bootcamps are designed to be intensive and practical, focusing on core skills and software; suitable for journalists seeking concentrated skill-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Our virtual and in-person workshops are an affordable way to get data & investigative training in a small-group setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshops are offered both virtually and in person, emphasize small-group instruction, and are positioned as a lower-cost training option.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinars
rubrics_metrics.description: We host digital events yearround aimed at educating journalist on some of the most pressing issues affecting the industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most webinars are free for IRE members and are recorded for future reference; they provide ongoing digital education on industry topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application-Based Training — Total Newsroom
rubrics_metrics.description: Small and mid-size newsrooms can apply for free custom training to ramp up their watchdog skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an application-based program targeted at small/mid-size newsrooms; selected newsrooms receive free, customized training to build investigative capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training for student journalists (MSI-funded)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students attending colleges and universities recognized as MSIs can train at workshops backed by the Gevers-Burns Diversity Endowed Fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility requires attendance at a recognized Minority-Serving Institution; funding (via the Gevers-Burns fund) supports student participation in workshops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Today's News for Tomorrow program
rubrics_metrics.description: Today’s News for Tomorrow offers newsrooms free training, digital preservation services and sustained support to ensure the long-term preservation and access of their digital assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program delivers free training plus digital preservation services and ongoing support to help newsrooms preserve and access digital assets long-term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships & Scholarships
rubrics_metrics.description: IRE makes available fellowships and scholarships to allow professional journalists, students and educators the opportunity to attend training events they might not otherwise be able to afford.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically include a one-year IRE membership and conference/seminar registration fees; some awards cover travel costs; applicants may apply for more than one scholarship/fellowship. Check specific award pages for application requirements and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom training (bespoke newsroom training)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get more bang for your buck with bespoke training tailored to your newsroom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Custom training is available virtually or in-person, offered on a sliding fee scale, and can be provided in Spanish upon request. Contact IRE for details and pricing.
